_note: The games library index, the twin of stories.json. The Games tab reads it, so a game is described once. Adding a game means an entry here plus its environmentle-<id>.html, GAME_URLS in index.html, and reconcileGames() in engine.js so the day cap counts it. 'playedKey' is the localStorage prefix the game writes its last-played date to. 'art' is a file in _images/games. 'type' is the filter label. 'detail' is the middle of the card's meta line, so it reads 'Type, detail, N min'.
